newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Hestia Insurance increases share capital.
newsitem.headline: Polish Hestia Insurance increases share capital.

text.p: Shareholders of Hestia Insurance SA have decided to increase its share capital by 14.7 million zlotys to 34.7 million, the Polish insurer's spokesman said on Wednesday.
Wojciech Fulek told Reuters the new shares were earmarked for Hestia's current shareholders among whom German insurer Alte Leipziger Europa, part of Alte Leipziger group, has an 88 percent stake.
Bank Gdanski holds 5.5 percent in the firm and the remaining stakes belong to several Polish institutions and individuals.

Last year Hestia Insurance had a net profit of 0.4 million zlotys on 93.3-million-zloty gross premiums and in the first half of 1996 it showed a net profit of 2.4 million zlotys on 99.2-million-zloty gross premiums.
